facts.fact: The acting president of the National Statistics Council says the ministry is preparing a new statistics bill as a comprehensive revision of the current statistics law, which dates from 1999 (Diwan FM, 5 June 2026; the 1999 law is the one in force, dated here to its year).
facts.system: Loi n° 99-32 du 13 avril 1999 relative au système national de la statistique

systems.system: Loi n° 99-32 du 13 avril 1999 relative au système national de la statistique
Stratégie nationale de développement de la statistique 2026-2030

note: The new bill is described as being prepared and about to be put forward, not published or tabled, so no draft fact.
